harnesses.property: For every symbolic [u8;32] with at least one nonzero byte, actual CodeSha256::new accepts and as_bytes preserves all 32 bytes exactly.
Actual production constructor rejects concrete lengths 0, 31, and 33, plus all-zero length 32.
For every bool, actual marker ingress accepts exactly true, rejects false with InvalidSubscription, and maps accepted marker back to true.

For every symbolic u64 cursor, actual production ingress preserves cursor including zero; CurrentHead(true) yields current-head Some(true); CurrentHead(false) and missing oneof reject with InvalidSubscription; direct constructors expose matching presence.

claim_scope: These follow-up theorems cover only CodeSha256 fixed 32-byte admission/preservation and SubscriptionStart/CurrentHead marker presence and ingress. They do not prove arbitrary strings outside fixed digest bytes, transport behavior, whole requests, expected revision, or whole-crate semantics.
